subject: Request: Aligning invoice submission windows + early-pay option for Archimedes
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@archimedes.ai>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: ProcureOps <procureops@archimedes.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:18:00 +0200
Subject: Supplier onboarding — invoice cutoff and early-pay request

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the warm welcome earlier. Two operational items from our procurement team that will impact our invoicing flow with Redwood: 1) our AP system batches invoices to Archimedes’ bank on the 1st and 15th of each month, and 2) we’re exploring an early-pay program for strategic vendors.

Can Redwood receive invoices with a cutoff of the 3rd/17th (to align with our remittance), and would you be open to an early-pay pilot (1–2% discount for net-15 settlement) for the first three months? Our goal is to avoid duplicate POs and to map the invoice lane correctly when we create the initial PO.

I attached a draft preferred terms doc (Proposed_MAPP_Terms_v2.docx) and a tax form for your vendor team. Happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement, Archimedes AI
elena@archimedes.ai

Attachments: Proposed_MAPP_Terms_v2.docx (docx), Archimedes_W9.pdf (pdf)

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@archimedes.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ProcureOps <procureops@archimedes.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — invoice cutoff and early-pay request

Elena — thanks for the details and the docs.

Quick answers now: we can map your invoice lane to the 3rd/17th cutoffs (that’s a simple routing rule on our AP intake), and we do offer an early-pay program through Finance for strategic vendors — typically handled as a short pilot with a signed addendum.

I’ll loop in Karthik (Finance lead) and Marissa (Vendor ops) to confirm approval path and DocuSign steps. Can you confirm the legal entity name we should use on the PO and the preferred remit-to bank details?

If it’s helpful, we can schedule a 30-min cadence next week to finalize PO routing and the pilot metrics (discount %, net days, enrollment period).

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwood.com

---

Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — invoice cutoff and early-pay request

Aisha — looping in Marissa for vendor onboarding logistics. A few notes from Finance:

- Early-pay pilots are allowed but need a signed commercial addendum and accounting sign-off.
- We prefer discounts to be expressed as a percentage against the invoice total (e.g., 1.5% for payment at net-15).
- For the pilot we need the projected monthly spend floor (min $ value) and a point-of-contact in Archimedes AP for remittance confirmation.

Marissa, can you confirm PO creation timing and whether our vendor portal can accept the 3rd/17th cutoffs as distinct invoice lanes? If not, we can route via a special remit code.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

On Tue, May 12, 2026 at 11:05 -0700, aisha_rahman wrote:
> I’ll loop in Karthik (Finance lead) and Marissa (Vendor ops) to confirm approval path...

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 10:16:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Supplier onboarding — invoice cutoff and early-pay request

Karthik / Aisha — we can accept multiple invoice lanes; we’ll set up two remit codes tied to the Archimedes vendor record: ARCH-3 (cutoff 3rd) and ARCH-17 (cutoff 17th). Steps:

1) Vendor profile + W9 uploaded to the portal (I’ve reviewed Archimedes_W9.pdf and it’s in good order).
2) Create PO to "Archimedes AI, Inc." (confirm legal entity) and include remit code on PO line.
3) For early-pay pilot: we’ll prepare a two-page addendum (terms + termination clause). Karthik — once you sign off on the % and floor, I’ll kick a DocuSign envelope.

Aisha — propose a 30-min sync on Mon 18 May, 09:00 PT to finalize.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: Early-pay pilot parameters for Archimedes

Team — confirmed with Finance leadership: we can approve a 1.5% discount for net-15 settlement as a 3-month pilot, subject to:

- Minimum monthly invoicing threshold of $25,000;
- Addendum signed and attached to the vendor record;
- One-week notice to terminate the pilot from either party.

Marissa — please generate the DocuSign envelope and include the addendum + PO reference (HD-38291). Aisha — please share Archimedes’ remit bank details and legal entity name before we send.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
